ctx.x: In Cleveland I spent my last -- I hit Cleveland from Lakeside, Ohio, with $1.60 in my pocket. I think I told you that prior. And I paid 60 cents to go in and hear that great Fletcher Henderson's band, Coleman Hawkins on tenor saxophone. And I just had to see that band. So that left me with a dollar. After I ate, that left me with sixty cents.
I lived three days on that sixty cents. That's a fact.
